props.name: itemsContainerClass
props.description: Additional classes for the menu container.

props.name: transition
props.description: Enables menu transition animations. Default: true

props.name: anchor
props.description:
Controls dropdown placement.
Accepts:
- `"bottom start"`
- `"top end"`
- `"right"`
- or object configuration for advanced placement.

props.name: renderItem
props.description:
Renderer for customizing how a menu item is displayed.
If omitted, the default item UI is used.

props.name: menuItemClass
props.description: Custom CSS classes applied to each menu item.

props.name: onMenuClick
props.description:
Called when a menu item is clicked.
Receives: (item, index)

props.name: triggerButton
props.description:
JSX element used as the trigger button.
Must NOT be provided when using renderTriggerButton.

props.name: renderTriggerButton
props.description:
Must NOT be provided when using triggerButton.
Custom trigger renderer.
Receives trigger UI state (open, focus, hover, etc.)
Must return a valid element.
